newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch AEX share index rises through 600 level.
newsitem.headline: Dutch AEX share index rises through 600 level.

text.p: The AEX index of the 25 most actively traded shares of the Amsterdam Stock Exchange gained 2.49 points at a new all-time high of 600.08 on Wednesday beating the previous intra-day record of 599.69 set on Tuesday.
The AEX hit a record closing high on Tuesday at 597.59.
Since the start of this year, the index has gained about 115 points or 24 percent, mainly tracking a Wall Street rally.

Dealers said they now expected the index to consolidate around here or possibly correct slightly. But longer-term the outlook was still positive, with the charts signalling the next target at between 625 and 630 points.
